description: Percent of Passenger Vehicle Road Tests Served Under 30 Days is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. This dataset shows the percentage of customers that obtained a road test appointment within 30 days of registering, by month. Coverage: Government of New Brunswick. The portal files it under the publisher Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Its tags are road test, épreuve de conduite pratique, wait time, délais d’attente, essai routier. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, OTHER, RDF, RSS. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - New Brunswick. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
